# miniz 3.1.2

Source: https://github.com/richgel999/miniz/releases/tag/3.1.2
Revision: `77d0dce8627735138c51770d1799a1ef48f2117d`

The server uses miniz to compress its browser page for HTTP downloads. Only
`miniz.c` and `miniz_tdef.c` are compiled, directly by `main/CMakeLists.txt`.
The compression library needs no separate installation or build step.

Upstream source files and the MIT license are unchanged. `miniz_export.h` is a
local static-build definition replacing the header normally generated by
upstream CMake. Decompression, ZIP archives, zlib-compatible APIs, file I/O and
time support are disabled. The inflate and ZIP headers remain because
upstream `miniz.h` includes them, but their implementation files are not needed.

HTTP negotiation and the gzip header/trailer are in `main/httpserver/http_gzip.c`.
No server configuration or compressed page is written to disk.
